release_notes: Promote the complete post-1.0.79 Dashboard lineage after the final #1560 P0 Smart Ordering blocker closed on main. Ship the Premium Smart WhatsApp Chatbot plus WhatsApp media/calling/campaign/inbox and Meta-template reliability fixes while preserving fail-closed runtime controls. Ship the certified Smart Ordering GA platform: menu, checkout, customer growth/loyalty, WhatsApp bridge, QR attribution, analytics, merchandising and FOODEX supply intelligence. Add menu/category/item media visibility, draft review-before-publish, business-level QR presets and bundled TCPDF fallback for QR SVG/PDF generation. Include updater canonical SemVer repair so malformed installed versions such as `1.084` self-heal to `1.0.84`, and keep first-contact WhatsApp consent unknown until explicit evidence exists. Synchronize Customer, Driver and Van release identities at 1.0.86+86 and build release artifacts only from an exact-head green promotion commit.
